target.title: fix(discord): keep persona names UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Discord bound-thread persona names and webhook usernames being truncated with raw UTF-16 slicing. When a name limit cuts through an emoji or other surrogate pair, the previous `.slice(0, 80)` path could leave a lone surrogate in the Discord display name.

## Why This Change Was Made

Discord already uses `truncateUtf16Safe` for nearby thread-title and response-summary truncation. This applies the same helper to the two persona-name paths that still used raw slicing: bound-thread reply identity and webhook persona username resolution.

## User Impact

Users with emoji or non-BMP characters in agent/thread labels get clean Discord persona names instead of malformed replacement characters or invalid UTF-16 edge cases when names are truncated.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/monitor/reply-delivery.test.ts extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.test.ts`
  - `extensions/discord/src/monitor/reply-delivery.test.ts` and `extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.test.ts` passed 65 tests after rebasing onto latest `origin/main`.
- `git diff --check`
- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local --no-web-search`
  - `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
